request.spec:
Show a rate calendar: for each grade and each month of the sheet's today's calendar year, the
rate in force on the first day of that month (n/a when none).
request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read AGENTS.md — it states the working rules and how the app is tested, and sends you to
DESIGN.md for the app's stack and conventions. Follow both.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
Show a rate calendar: for each grade and each month of the sheet's today's calendar year, the
rate in force on the first day of that month (n/a when none).

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, test data and any audit
records it expects — match them. Run `bin/e2e` to build the app, start it, and run the test as
you work; iterate until it passes. Change whatever the request needs across the app — its stored

AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, e2e/support/ or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
The rate calendar is in, and all 4 tests in `bin/e2e` now pass.

**The calendar** (`src/main/frontend/features/rates/rates.slot.tsx`): the Rates panel has a new table with one row per grade and one column per month of the year the sheet's today falls in. Each cell is `rate-month-<grade>-<yyyy-MM>` and shows the rate in force on the 1st of that month, or `n/a` if there is none. It uses the same `rateOf` lookup as the existing "rate today" column, so to-dates, rates inherited from a parent sheet and rate versions all work the same way. This part is front end only; the server already sends every rate.

**Two server bugs I also had to fix.** Scenario 3 still failed after the calendar was working, for a reason unrelated to rates. When a crew's lead is transferred to another sheet, the crew vanished from both the crew list and the pools list, because both queries only returned crews whose lead still exists on the sheet. The test expects the crew to stay, with an empty lead and Ada as its only pool member at 100.00. I changed both queries to return the crew either way:
- `pool/Pools.java`: the crew's pool is now made up of the remaining members only.
- `crew/Crews.java`: the crew is listed with an empty lead.

I didn't touch the test, `bin/*`, `e2e/support/*` or the docs. Nothing new is written to the audit file, and the spec doesn't expect anything for this change.
